decisions.statement: A name equal to the old name becomes the new name.
A name opening with the old name and a slash keeps the tail past that name.
A name with the old name anywhere else names no package renamed.
Every specifier a body names a module by is read for the package.
A specifier respelled is written as JSON spells that specifier.
A string naming no module is left as that string is.
Nothing here reads the disk or the index.
Nothing here judges whether a name may be renamed.
No package or path this module's test names is one this repository has.

definition: a package's name where a string has it
